changes.title: Legend rim
items: Small stones, toadstools, stumps and posts edge each sleeping legend's circle, in its area's own kind, leaving the way in open

changes.title: Circle baby dances
items: When its area's party comes, the baby in a legend's circle dances there in its circle instead of going off to the soundsystem

changes.title: Irregular coast
items: The island's coast is no longer a perfect circle: gentle bays and headlands, different on every map, still round on the whole
